enabled.label: Enable scrobbling
enabled.description: Master on/off for Last.fm scrobbling. Optional; default off.

api_key.label: Last.fm API Key
api_key.description: Your Last.fm API key. Create a free API account to get one.

shared_secret.label: Last.fm Shared Secret
shared_secret.description: The "Shared secret" shown next to your API key on your Last.fm API accounts page. Used to sign authenticated requests.

callback_url.label: OAuth Callback URL
callback_url.description: The Callback URL you registered for your Last.fm API application, used for the authorization handshake. Optional — defaults to this server.

username.label: Last.fm Username
username.description: Display-only: the Last.fm account scrobbles are sent to (set during authorization).
